verdict.rationale: Outlook is an email product, so scheduled send and undo send are applicable, but the evidence documents neither. The only related item is creating a draft 'to send later' via Graph, which is a manual one-off workaround rather than a scheduled delivery time. Nothing describes an undo-send grace window.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
